main_measure.name: t of OLS slope of excess 10-bar forward return on forecast (forecast > 0 grid samples)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= +2 on >= 30 cases and mean excess > 0; reject if slope t <= -2 on >= 30 cases; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean excess 10-bar return over forecast > 0 samples above 0

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and +2.
reading: The coin's mean 10-bar return is the mean of all its non-overlapping 10-bar grid returns over all windows (not only forecast > 0 samples), the slope t is the ordinary OLS t with intercept, and the situation is read from the raw component value > 0 (price-based prior 20-bar high where it is missing).
